lean4.content_append: Noema portable installation: resolve ../../vendor/lean4-skills/plugins/lean4 from this Skill's directory (the Noema Skill source header). This contains bin/lean4-skills-* wrappers and lib/scripts; invoke wrappers with their resolved absolute paths. References are bundled here in references/. No host-native /lean4:* commands, hooks or subagent definitions are installed. The optional lean-lsp MCP must be explicitly enabled for a prepared Lean project; without it use the documented CLI fallback.

servers.title: Lean LSP MCP
servers.description: Optional Lean diagnostics and mathlib search; requires uvx and a prepared Lean project.

math-writing.title: Math writing
math-writing.description: English mathematical prose, precise claims, introductions and pre-submission review
math-writing.preamble: Keep every hypothesis and the exact strength of each result; never strengthen a claim while rewording it. Define notation before first use and keep it consistent across the document. Mark what is proved, what is cited, and what is conjectured.

math-verification.title: Math verification
math-verification.description: Proof planning and audit, Lean/Mathlib formalization, symbolic checks
math-verification.preamble: A claim counts as verified only by a checked proof: a Lean file that compiles without sorry or axioms beyond the standard ones, or a written proof that survives proof-review. Symbolic or numerical computation is evidence, not proof; state its assumptions (field, domain, dimension, branch). Report any step that remains unverified.

quantum-computing.title: Quantum computing
quantum-computing.description: Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane and QuTiP, with SymPy for exact algebra
quantum-computing.preamble: Use Nielsen-Chuang notation unless the document says otherwise. Qubit order differs between frameworks: Qiskit is little-endian (qubit 0 is the rightmost bit of a basis label), while Cirq and PennyLane put the first qubit or wire leftmost. State the convention whenever a bitstring, statevector or matrix crosses frameworks or reaches the text. For small systems prefer exact statevector or density-matrix checks, and say whether a result comes from noiseless simulation, a noise model, or hardware.

software-dev.title: Software development
software-dev.description: Design, plans, test-driven development, debugging, verification and code review
software-dev.preamble: These Skills come from obra/superpowers. They may mention other superpowers Skills, slash commands or subagents; use those only if this session actually provides them. Where a Skill conflicts with the repository's own AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, the repository wins.
